implementation.summary: Management AI cockpit, trading-pulse, portfolio and persona-fleet context reads carry typed ManagementObservation owner evidence. Aggregate status preserves the worst contributing owner status and every owner's provenance; missing observation times remain null. Rollback owner availability is bound to the actual port outcome, with legacy generic route best-effort behavior preserved.
implementation.current_fix: Persona fleet now shares one telemetry read per distinct runtime between its snippets and owner observations. Persona composition, binding, strategy, session, teaching-session, capital-pool and allowed-action reads return failure observations instead of discarding other owners or personas. Per-persona observations also accompany each snippet. Pool enrichment reuses its observation read. Tenant filtering precedes nested owner provenance. The 20-item display limit does not hide a later persona's unavailable owner.
implementation.regressions: Durable test_persona_fleet_read_failures.py covers seven independent raising owners, persona composition failure, two personas sharing flaky telemetry, all-healthy evidence, seven foreign-tenant reads, pool read reuse, and failure beyond the display limit. The older incomplete-owner fixture now expects degraded instead of incorrectly claiming all owners healthy.
implementation.boundary: Product read models only; no development task authority, repository-writing product endpoint, synthetic fallback, domain writer or hosted deployment change.
implementation.rollback_plan: Return typed unavailable owner observations for a disabled or failing projection. Do not revert to generic/synthetic reads or restore seed/task-status product truth. No persistence migration is introduced.
